description: Fixed by formal-mode-aware call scanning; covered by verification_diff_modular_call.adb.

Redundant_Boolean_Comparison fired on a same-named enumeration literal instead of Standard.True/False; fixed by requiring the non-literal operand's type to resolve to Standard.Boolean; covered by redundant_boolean_comparison_clean.adb.

Dead_Store, Overwritten_Assignment, and Repeated_Statement fired on Volatile/Atomic/Address-clause objects (memory-mapped hardware registers), where a write is observable on its own and does not need a later Ada-level read; fixed by an Is_Externally_Observable exemption in Adalang_Analyzer.Checks.Data_Flow; covered by volatile_register_writes_clean.adb.

Global_Contract_Mismatch (and related Global/Depends/SPARK-readiness checks) fired on declarations with no SPARK_Mode aspect of their own nested inside a package/subprogram/task/protected body or spec marked SPARK_Mode => Off, because Effective_SPARK_Enabled only inspected the declaration itself and never walked up to the enclosing scope that the mode is inherited from; fixed by adding that lexical walk in Adalang_Analyzer.SPARK_Dependency_Analysis, Adalang_Analyzer.SPARK_Readiness, and Adalang_Analyzer.Flow_Interp; reproduced against AdaCore/spark2014 Tokeneer example, alarm-interfac.adb; covered by spark_mode_off_global_clean.adb.

Uninitialized_Output did not credit an out-mode parameter as initialized when the write happened inside a called nested subprogram whose own Global contract declares Output/In_Out mode on that variable as an up-level global, because Statement_Writes_Parameter only scanned actual parameters passed at the call site and never consulted the callee's own Global contract; fixed by adding Callee_Writes_Global in Adalang_Analyzer.SPARK_Readiness; reproduced against AdaCore/spark2014 Tokeneer example, configdata.adb (ValidateFile / ReadLatchUnlock and siblings); covered by uninitialized_output_nested_call_clean.adb.

Depends_Contract_Mismatch, Incomplete_Depends_Contract, and Missing_Depends_Contract mishandled combined-output Depends syntax "(A, B) => C": Ada's own aggregate grammar has no comma-separated choice list (only "|" separates discrete choices), so Libadalang parses the parenthesized designator list as a nested positional aggregate rather than as separate identifier designators; every affected check only recognized a designator that was itself a plain identifier, so both outputs were silently dropped and the shared input was misreported as unused ("listed after null"); fixed by expanding the nested aggregate's own associations in Adalang_Analyzer.SPARK_Dependency_Analysis.Parse_Depends and Adalang_Analyzer.SPARK_Readiness.Collect_Depends_Outputs; reproduced against AdaCore/spark2014 Tokeneer example, configdata.adb (ReadDuration); covered by depends_combined_output_clean.adb.

Uninitialized_Output flagged composite (record- or array-typed) out parameters that were fully initialized field-by-field or element-by-element, because Same_Parameter only recognized a plain identifier as referring to the tracked parameter, not a selected component (Param.Field := ...) or an indexed/sliced name (Param (I) := ...); fixed by walking down through nested Dotted_Name and Call_Expr prefixes to the innermost identifier in Adalang_Analyzer.SPARK_Readiness.Same_Parameter; reproduced against AdaCore/spark2014 Tokeneer example, admin.adb (Logon), cert-attr-auth.adb and siblings (Extract); covered by uninitialized_output_composite_clean.adb. A remaining case (auditlog.adb, SetFileDetails) writes an array through a for-loop over its full index range rather than by literal index or field name; proving that covers every index would require reasoning about loop bounds matching the array's index subtype, a materially harder problem left open (see quality/external_corpus_findings.md).

Uninitialized_Output flagged an out parameter forwarded positionally to another overload of the same subprogram name, when several overloads shared the same parameter count and modes (a common shape for a family of Encode/Decode procedures differing only in one parameter's type): Call.P_Call_Params demands one fully precise overload resolution for the whole call and returns nothing when that fails, and the per-actual fallback Assoc.P_Get_Params (Imprecise_Fallback => True) can itself raise in the same heavily-overloaded scenario; fixed in Adalang_Analyzer.SPARK_Readiness.Statement_Writes_Parameter by falling back, for a purely positional actual, to resolving only the callee name (a more lenient operation that still succeeds) and pairing by literal position via the new Callee_Formal_At_Position; reproduced against cubesatlab/cubedos, cubedos-lib-xdr.adb (the Encode family); covered by uninitialized_output_overloaded_forward_clean.adb. A distinct, narrower case remained open: a scalar written unconditionally inside a `for` loop with statically non-empty bounds and no early exit was still treated as possibly-unwritten, because every loop kind was conservatively assumed to be skippable; closed as FP-009.

Uninitialized_Output flagged a scalar out parameter written unconditionally inside a `for` loop with a statically non-empty range (e.g. `for I in 1 .. 3 loop ... Value := ...; end loop;`), because every loop kind was conservatively treated as possibly executing zero times; fixed in Adalang_Analyzer.SPARK_Readiness.Interpret_Initialization by special-casing `for` loops: when the iteration range's bounds are statically known (via Adalang_Analyzer.Flow_Eval.Choice_Interval) and non-empty, and the loop body contains no exit/return/raise/goto anywhere (the new Contains_Loop_Escape), the body's own computed initialization result is trusted instead of discarded, since nothing can leave the loop before finishing a pass; while/plain loops and any `for` loop containing an early exit remain conservatively unresolved, to avoid trading this false positive for a false negative; found in cubedos-lib-xdr.adb's Encode family (the loop-based writes remaining after FP-008); verified with a fixture faithfully copying that loop shape rather than a fresh live re-run of the checkout; covered by uninitialized_output_static_loop_clean.adb (clean) and uninitialized_output_static_loop_early_exit.adb (still flags with an early exit present).
